label: 05 · Window Card
description: The card for the window or the case, at print size: your photo takes the top of the card, and the name, the spec and the price sit centred under it, a thin line in your colour on the card's edge. A still, ready to print and trim at A7, A6 or 4x6. Every picture edits on the canvas: drop a photo in, drag the area it fills, pick whether it covers or fits. With no photo of your own, a real piece from the starter pack stands in, never clip art.

cardSize.label: Card size
cardSize.description: Portrait at 300 dpi: a7 (74 x 105 mm) by default, a6 (105 x 148 mm) or 4x6 inches.

brandName.label: Brand
brandName.description: The small wordmark at the top of the card. A logo replaces it. Required.

brandLogo.label: Brand logo
brandLogo.description: Zero or one logo in place of the wordmark. Empty draws the brand name.

brandLogoRegion.label: Brand logo area
brandLogoRegion.description: Where the logo goes - or the brand name, when there is no logo - drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it. Empty keeps its place in the layout.

brandLogoFit.label: Brand logo fit
brandLogoFit.description: contain shows the whole logo inside its area; cover fills the area and crops the logo's edges. Default: contain.

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.description: The short line above the name, in the accent: a collection, a season, a reason. Empty removes it.

productName.label: Piece
productName.description: The name of the piece, large. Required.

specLine.label: Spec
specLine.description: Metal, stone, size - one or two lines. Empty removes it.

price.label: Price
price.description: The price as a number, above 0, drawn large with thousands separators.

stampLine.label: Under the price
stampLine.description: A quiet line under the price. Empty removes it.

productArt.label: Bundled art
productArt.description: Which illustration stands in when there is no photo: solitaire, band, pendant, studs, hoops, tennis, diamond, watch or ringbox. Tinted by Metal tone and Stone tone. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

metal.label: Metal tone
metal.description: The metal the bundled art is drawn in: gold, rose, white or platinum. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

stone.label: Stone tone
stone.description: The stone the bundled art is drawn with: diamond, sapphire, ruby, emerald, amethyst, aquamarine, pearl, morganite, citrine, garnet, peridot, opal, topaz or tanzanite. (Drawn only if the starter pack is missing.)

productImage.label: Photo
productImage.description: Zero or one photo of the piece. It is the hero: cover-cropped to fill the top of the card. Empty shows a starter photo from the pack until you add yours.

productImageRegion.label: Photo area
productImageRegion.description: Where the photo goes, drawn on the preview: drag the rect to move it, pull a corner to resize it - the photo fills the rect at its fit, so a tighter rect crops it. Empty keeps its place in the layout.

productImageFit.label: Photo fit
productImageFit.description: cover fills the photo's area and crops what spills over; contain shows all of it inside the area, the paper around it. Default: cover.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: ivory (warm paper, dark text), noir (near-black, light text), velvet (deep blue, ivory text) or blush (rose paper, brown text). Background and Text override either half.

accent.label: Accent
accent.description: The brand colour as #rrggbb: the line on the card's edge, the kicker and the price.

background.label: Background
background.description: The paper colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

ink.label: Text
ink.description: The text colour as #rrggbb. Empty takes the theme's.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only: check the layout contract (every line fits its box) and draw it over the card.
